title: The Value That Never Changed: What QML Can Follow Across the Boundary
fallback: The question here is how one side of a boundary learns that the other side changed, and QML is one answer to it. Lesson 09-01 asks the same question with signals and slots in plain C++ and needs no QML runtime. Without Qt Quick, do 09-01 and come back.

artifact.note: asks the meta object which properties QML can follow, and is honest about the one bug it cannot see
